newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Burns Philp to meet today over results.
newsitem.headline: Burns Philp to meet today over results.

text.p: Food group Burns Philp & Co Ltd said on Monday its earlier request for a trading halt was due to a company director's meeting today to consider the third quarter results and other matters affecting the company.

"The reasons for the trading halt are that a scheduled meeting of directors of Burns, Philp & Co Ltd is to be held today to consider the results for the third quarter of the 1996/97 financial year and other matters affecting the Company," Burns Philp said in a brief statement.
The yeast and spices maker posted an 18 percent rise in net profit to A$48.2 million in the six months to December 31, 1997.

"It is anticipated that decisions will be made by directors at that meeting which will require announcement to the market as soon as practicable after the conclusion of the meeting," Burns Philp said.
Burns Philp shares closed 14 cents lower at A$1.85 on Friday.
